The '''Malita Tal Environmentalism Award''' was an award given to commemorate efforts to restore natural ecosystems<ref name="Superstar Codex" /> by [[3630 BBY]].<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|4.6}} As the Codex entry [[Malita Tal]], which mentions the Malita Tal Environmentalism Award, was added with Game Update 4.6, the award must have been created by that same [[Standard year/Legends|year]].</ref> It was created in the name of [[Malita Tal]], a [[Zakuulan]] superstar known for her humanitarian and environmental work, which included the preservation of wildlife on<ref name="Superstar Codex" /> the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Zakuul Codex">{{TORcite|exp=kotfe|type=codex|Zakuul}}</ref> [[Zakuul]].<ref name="Superstar Codex" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Malita Tal Environmentalism Award was mentioned in the [[2015]] [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire|''Knights of the Fallen Empire'']] expansion to the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]], ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', in the Codex entry for Malita Tal.<ref name="Superstar Codex" />
